name: client-runtime-identity-account-address
executionConcern: client runtime identity, session isolation, account and address ownership
objective: Make app-client boot, authentication, session/device/push lifecycle, account identity and address/privacy behavior fail closed and derive only from Identity plus canonical DSH address truth.
truthOwner: Identity owns authentication/session; DSH owns client address/service-area/privacy operational truth.
journeys: address create/update/select/delete and privacy-safe service-area binding

tasks.currentProblem: Static composition proves SecureStore session, client role/surface gate and address screens exist, but does not prove stale actor state, cross-actor PII access, offline recovery or address/geofence mutations remain fail-closed.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Identity session restoration/logout/device/push lifecycle and DSH client-address contracts/handlers/repositories; correct the first authoritative divergence and remove only proven local fallback.
tasks.targetState: A client can act only as the authenticated client, session change clears stale actor state, and every usable address is authorized and bound to canonical active service-area truth.
tasks.action: Implement owner-first fixes across Identity bindings and client-address vertical slice, then migrate only app-client consumers and preserve privacy/audit constraints.
mustNotChange: Do not use device fingerprint as authorization.
Do not trust client-supplied actor or operator context.
Do not expose raw address PII across actors.
Do not call map providers directly from app-client.
acceptanceCriteria: Logout/relogin cannot retain another client's data.
Address writes fail closed outside active geofence and unauthorized object scope.
Offline/retry states do not fabricate successful identity or address truth.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore a parallel truth source.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U001 implementation commit after owner correction, directly affected consumer migration, cleanup and all linked checks.
